excavation_context.character_description: Adult male grad student museum preparator, short dark hair, tanned skin, wearing a light blue tee shirt under a crisp white lab coat, blue jean slacks, and black dress shoes. Wears signature thin-rimmed black rectangular lens glasses.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_1 is in a museum holding area, shining a flashlight at a newly arrived, heavy block of pebble-packed tan conglomerate matrix. Trapped within the packed gravel texture is a thick, water-worn theropod limb joint. Dramatic high-contrast spotlighting defining the bumpy pebble shapes and reflecting off his black rectangular glasses. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
